root_cause.text: The conditional logic in `dcn401_init_hw()` allowed calling `update_bw_bounding_box()` without validating that the function pointer is non-NULL when the `freq_changed` branch evaluated to true independently of the callback pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "the existing condition: `((!fams2_enable && update_bw_bounding_box) || freq_changed)` does not guarantee this, as the freq_changed branch can evaluate to true independently of the callback pointer." The patch separates the update condition from the pointer checks, ensuring `dc->res_pool->funcs->update_bw_bounding_box`, `dc->clk_mgr`, and `dc->clk_mgr->bw_params` are all validated before the call.

intent_record.what: Reformatted the FAMS version check comment, introduced a local variable 'dchub_ref_freq_changed', restructured the outer if condition from '(!fams2_enable && funcs) || freq_changed' to '(!fams2_enable || freq_changed) && funcs && clk_mgr && bw_params', and removed the inner if (dc->clk_mgr) guard, moving null checks into the outer condition.
intent_record.how: Ensures that dc->res_pool->funcs->update_bw_bounding_box, dc->clk_mgr, and dc->clk_mgr->bw_params are all non-null before calling update_bw_bounding_box.
